atime_observation.qualification: Atime is read before each content hash. A pre-existing atime difference would be compatible with intervening reads and is not evidence of byte or stable-metadata mutation; no producing reader is inferred. Reading during this postcheck may advance atime. Inventory atime is not asserted immutable; operation records preserve each target at operation entry.

free_space.qualification: These are operation-window free-space observations, not an independent attribution of every free byte to cloning. Logical duplicate size is not a guaranteed physical reclaim amount; unrelated concurrent changes are not attributed.

metadata_limitations: Inode changes are intended and verified; ctime and birth time may change. This postcheck authenticates retained bytes and required stable metadata at its bounded observation, not future immutability or compiler/proof provenance.
scope: Separate read-only operational postcheck of exactly 188 retained compiled targets and their 94 canonical sources from closed workers 164–168. No 169+ file read, project program/proof/checker/replay/experiment execution, mathematical computation, object interpretation, clone, deletion, chmod, chown, utime or replacement. Does not extend any mathematical audit observation window.
